title: DNA extraction and quantification
author: Rene Flores Clavo
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bsj4ncqw

steps.title: Resuspend cells in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend ~50 mg fresh bacterial biomass in 400 µL 1× TE buffer (10 mM Tris‑HCl, 1 mM EDTA, pH 8.0).

steps.title: Lysozyme digestion
steps.instruction: Add 1 µL lysozyme (100 mg/mL), vortex briefly, then incubate 1 h at 37 °C.

steps.title: SDS and Proteinase K treatment
steps.instruction: Add 67.5 µL 10 % SDS (pre‑heated to 65 °C) and 2.5 µL Proteinase K (10 mg/mL), vortex briefly, and incubate 10 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: CTAB/NaCl addition and incubation
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL 5 M NaCl and 100 µL CTAB/NaCl solution (0.03 M CTAB, 0.07 M NaCl), both pre‑heated to 65 °C; vortex until the mixture turns whitish, then incubate 10 min at 65 °C.

steps.title: Chloroform/isoamyl extraction
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (24:1), vortex 10 s, and centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 5 min.

steps.title: DNA precipitation with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the ~800 µL aqueous supernatant to a new tube and add isopropanol equal to 0.6 × the supernatant volume; gently invert to mix and precipitate DNA.

steps.title: Cold incubation for precipitation
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at –20 °C for 30–60 min if DNA precipitation is not yet visible.

steps.title: Pellet collection by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 12,000 rpm for 5 min; discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 70% ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold 70 % ethanol (pre‑chilled at –20 °C), centrifuge 12,000 rpm for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Wash pellet with 100% ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice‑cold 100 % ethanol (pre‑chilled at –20 °C), centrifuge 12,000 rpm for 5 min, and discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 4 °C, 12,000 rpm for 1 min to remove residual ethanol; allow the pellet to air‑dry briefly at room temperature.

steps.title: Final drying in speedvac
steps.instruction: Invert tubes, place on absorbent paper, and dry in a speedvac at 36 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 20 µL Milli‑Q water (add more water if needed based on pellet concentration).

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Assess DNA quality by electrophoresis: load various DNA concentrations and a λ‑phage control (50 ng/µL) on a 1 % agarose gel in 1× TBE, run 30 min at 5 V cm⁻¹.
